item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem:
Meera notices that her school in Delhi has longer days and stronger sunshine in June, but shorter days and weaker sunshine in December.

Which property of Earth makes seasons like this happen?

options.A: Earth's axis is tilted and keeps the same tilt as Earth revolves around the Sun
options.B: Earth moves closer to the Sun in June and farther away in December
options.C: Earth spins on its axis once every 24 hours
options.D: Earth has a spherical shape that blocks the Sun's light at night
